name: SeasonsRewardsU64List
summary: One u64-set member body of the SeasonsRewards replicated state in the client reader's element-count-zero branch: a prefix-varint delta count (pinned to 0), the strict zero-or-one delta, then a prefix-varint element count and that many big-endian u64. The non-zero branch is the client's masked id-keyed map; the recorded body takes the zero branch, so the card pins the count to 0 and refuses anything else.
purpose: Name the u64 member layout the SeasonsRewards presence mask selects (group 0 member 6 of codec.seasons-rewards-replicated-state), so the mask card references a record instead of carrying the container's layout itself.

fields.name: deltaCount
fields.note: The prefix-varint count 0x14365f1e0 reads before it branches. It is 0 in the measured activitiesTasks member, which selects the reader's +0x78 branch 0x14365f520; the non-zero masked-map branch has no instance, so the card bounds this field to 0 and refuses anything else.

fields.name: delta
fields.note: The zero-count branch 0x14365f520: a strict zero-or-one presence byte through FUN_1461adf60, then one prefix varint when it is 1. The measured activitiesTasks body carries flag 0 (no delta).

fields.name: elements
fields.note: A second prefix-varint element count and that many big-endian u64, read by 0x1415bcdb0 through 0x14087af30. 21 elements in the measured body.
